lines.text: After their meal, Princess and Stall III lie down side by side on the floor.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Are you asleep?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: No, my body isn't tired enough to fall asleep.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: You've turned into a proper worker.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: So you're going back to the Ark?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You heard.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Free Rat too?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: How'd you know?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Both of you stink.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: *Sniff, sniff* No I don't.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You do.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'm deliberating about whether to go or not.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: There are too many variables.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Who exactly are you, Princess? *Cough*

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I am the highest authority in the V.T.C.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I used to be called "Your Holiness."

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'm the head of V.T.C., where I'm regarded as a deity.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'm very old, even though I look about your age right now.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: My real age is closer to two hundred.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: No one can live that long.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Sure they can. Theoretically, if you get injected with Evergreen, you could live into your mid-two-hundreds.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: But I never got Evergreen. I survived this long by transferring my brain to different bodies.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I would take a young, sturdy body and live in it until it reaches its mid-twenties, and then I'd transfer my brain to a new body, over and over.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: So you became a Nikke?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: No. I despise those scrap-metal bodies, which is why I moved into human bodies.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Granted, I'm starting to regret that decision now...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: In any case, it was one of the crown jewels of our technology. The Central Government shut it down, but they made an exception for me.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: But what about the original people in those bodies?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Dead, probably. Or their brains got taken and they were turned into Nikkes.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Oh, so you were a bad person, huh?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I killed a lot of people for power.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Looking back on it all now...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Hmph, I lived gloriously.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Does that mean you're going back to the Ark to do bad stuff again?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I told you, I'm still deciding.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Are you out of money? Should I give you some?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Forget it. You keep it.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: It's not like I can use it anyway. *Cough*

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Spend it on treatment.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: No, they already told me they can't cure me here.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Ever the dump, this place.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: People born in the Outer Rim usually don't live past their thirties.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: If you've got something to say, say it.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Can I touch your face?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: ... You keep wanting to touch me every chance you get.
Stall III reaches out and traces Princess's face.
Princess quietly looks at Stall III.
Her eyes don't seem to be looking at anything at all.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Looks like your vision is almost gone...

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Hehe. I figured you knew.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: How could I not? You always slam into walls and trip over things.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Born in the muck, never once tasting a proper life... I feel sad for you.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I was happy. And I still am.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Will you come with me?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Yeah, I'd like to.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: As it happens, I needed a human shield, in case of emergencies.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You'll be perfect.
Princess removes her glasses,
and places them on Stall III's face.
*Bzzzz*

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Huh? What's going on? Everything's flashing.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Give it a moment.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: There.
Princess puts the glasses back on.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I've recorded your brainwaves.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: ... My brainwaves?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: When we get back to the Ark, I'll give you a gift.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: This is preparation for that.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Mm... I don't really get it, but okay.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Let's go tomorrow.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: To the Ark.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Good night, Princess.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Go ahead and sleep. I still have things to finish up.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Is it something to do with that pretty lady that's always on your screen?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Yes. Now that I've scanned your brainwaves, I can finalize everything.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I still don't get what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Hmph. A fool like you wouldn't understand anyway.
The next day.
*Bam! Bam! Bam!*
Princess is woken up by a pounding at the door.
She rubs her eyes and opens the door.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What is it...?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: This is bad! Really bad!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What are you doing? Why are you pounding on my door so early in the morning?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: There's a manhunt out for you across the entire Outer Rim!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: For me...?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Yeah! You!

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: The bounty on you is a hundred million!

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Th-there are already soldiers and Nikkes in the Outer Rim!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Soldiers...? Must be the Central Government.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: They finally found me... or someone tipped them off.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Let's go to Big Madam's first. It's risky, but she's got a hideout nobody knows about.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: A-and if you've got a bit of cash, she can even get you some guards!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Ready.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Where to?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Big Madam's.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: We'll stop by there first, then head to where we were originally going. I've already sent word that we're coming.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: For now, let's go say goodbye.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: You really act quickly when you make up your mind.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Okay, let's go.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: We have to be quick.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: What on earth did you do to make the Central Government come after you?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I must have sinned a great deal in a past life.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: ... I've got a safe place you can stay hidden for now.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: It's still a little dangerous, but it shouldn't be a problem for you.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: No, I'm only here to say farewell.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'm headed to the Ark. There's someone who promised to come get me.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Thank you for everything you've done, Big Madam.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: I see. So that's what you decided.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: What...? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'm leaving. I really do owe you one.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Big Madam.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I've got a lot saved up, don't I?

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: Yeah, it's certainly not a little.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Could you... *cough* Could you use it to assign Princess a guard?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Just until she reaches the Ark.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What are you talking about? We're both going.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Princess... I can't go with you.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: You know why.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I can barely see anything now. I'll only slow you down.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Go and be happy, Princess. But don't do anything bad.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What are you talking about...?
*Boom!*
The door breaks apart with a loud bang.
Mass-produced Nikkes emerge through the thick smoke.

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: Target sighted. Moving in to secure.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: I swear... I told you to wait just a little longer.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Big Madam...?

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: And I also said not to do it here. It'll scare off the customers.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You sold me out.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: That's not a very nice way to put it, Princess.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: We'd be as good as dead if we refused to cooperate with the Central Government.

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: I am sorry. I hope you'll forgive me.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Free Rat...?! You too...!

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: I-I didn't do anything! I swear I didn't!

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: B-Big Madam! Y-you said you were gonna help her! Right?!

lines.speaker: bigmadam
lines.text: ... Did you forget where we are? This is the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: Everyone, freeze. Cooperate and no one will be harm—

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Aaaaah!
Free Rat charges at the mass-produced Nikkes.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Run!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat*

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: Wait! Cease fire!
Free Rat collapses with blood spewing everywhere.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Free... Rat...?

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: We have a civilian casualty. I repeat, we have a civilian casualty.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: It... wasn't me...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: I didn't... betray...
Free Rat stops moving.

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: ... Roger that. We will no longer worry about casualties among Outer Rim civ... err, humans.

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: Proceeding to secure the targ...
The mass-produced Nikke looks at the hand of the fallen Free Rat.
Something hangs from her finger.

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: A safety pin...?

lines.speaker: CGnikke
lines.text: Grenade!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Hrrngh!
Princess grabs Stall III's hand and runs.
*Booooom!*
The explosion engulfs the area.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Agh... Arrgh...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: L-let's go...! She'll be waiting at the partition...!

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Prin...cess... Go alone...
Princess takes Stall III's hand.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Let's go...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: We're going to the Ark together...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: We'll go... cure your illness... and fix everything...

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: *Cough, cough*

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Let's go. Let's go. Together...

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: I... I can't see anything...

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: It's all... dark.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: It's okay...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: It's bright in the Ark.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You'll be able to see everything there.
